constraints: If message does not fit the display area (roughly 50 characters, varies by system/font), it may appear truncated.
Default button titles are "OK" and "Cancel" unless overridden by OKButtonTitle/CancelButtonTitle; buttons are resized to fit custom titles.
Sets the OK system variable to 1 if the user clicks OK (or presses Enter), or 0 if the user clicks Cancel.
Returns the entered text on OK, or an empty string on Cancel; convert with Num or Date if a numeric/date value is expected.
Must not be called from a form/object method's On Activate or On Deactivate event handler, since that causes an endless loop.
For gathering multiple pieces of information, prefer a custom form presented with DIALOG rather than chaining several Request dialogs.
